name: 汤头条
notes: Delivery-only Local-First migration over Test20. The exact Test20 25-module order is preserved and one settings/version overlay is appended. First install writes 26 immutable JS modules to Hiker local files through Local Module Manager 2.2.0; normal startup directly requires those local files and does not load Remote Manager/Bootstrap/GitHub code. Test16 image handling, Test10/Test15 long-video and preview playback, Test20 content contracts, and the known short-video 2–3 second limitation are intentionally unchanged.
